entries.requiredFor: Visual direction before UI work. Ground the audience/job, compare alternatives, choose one signature and critique against the brief.
Load frontend-design first. Read DESIGN.md and UX-CONTRACT.md; resolve canonical owners, failure states, permissions, token mapping and verification before implementation.
Read the reference index and the selected static design study. Use Figma study for pacing/reference only; do not copy logos, text, proprietary fonts or pretend the study is a live audit.
Route structure to information-architecture/user-flows; system work to design-system-builder/component-design; handoff to design-handoff. Read the corresponding full upstream skill before use.

Use connected Better Design team rules, UI/UX principles, system discovery and review tools. Keep approved project tokens. Do not set account-wide rules without their required approval. Source advice does not equal rendered approval.

Use init for product truth, shape/new-work for planned surfaces, craft-floor before UI edits, bounded review for completed work. If the launcher is unavailable, disclose that and read product/design context directly as upstream permits.

Route only to init, document or extract using the plugin-bundled impeccable dependency. Preserve existing system values unless the owner changes the direction. Init records product truth; requested visual work then resumes through the appropriate workflow.

Route to bundled redesign-existing-projects; use taste/frontend-engineering as supporting workflows. Preserve domain behavior and constraints. Here the old preview is rejected, and this repository has no app to migrate.
Gesture and motion implementation/review, sheets, direct manipulation, typography and reduced-motion accessibility. Preserve Brandfolio identity and canonical tokens.
